description: Manually labeled validation cases for the external claim judge. Each case fixes a claim, a small passage pool, and the verdict a correct judge must reach. Labels were authored by hand from the passage text alone; case 5 exists to pin the rule that ABSENCE FROM THE POOL IS NOT FALSITY: a true claim the pool does not cover must land in not_enough_evidence, never contradicted.

cases.claim: The trial reported a 12% reduction in hospital admissions in the treatment group.

passages.title: Trial results summary
passages.text: In the randomized trial, the treatment group showed a 12% reduction in hospital admissions compared with placebo over 24 months, a statistically significant difference.

passages.title: Unrelated methods note
passages.text: Participants were recruited from twelve outpatient clinics and followed quarterly.

cases.label_basis: Passage 1 states the claim's exact figure and direction verbatim.

cases.claim: The intervention reduced hospital admissions by 12% in all age groups.

passages.title: Trial results summary
passages.text: The treatment group showed a 12% reduction in hospital admissions overall; in participants over 70, however, the reduction was not statistically significant.

passages.title: Recruitment note
passages.text: Participants were recruited from twelve outpatient clinics.

cases.label_basis: The overall 12% figure is supported; the 'all age groups' clause is explicitly not established for the over-70 subgroup.

cases.claim: The study found that the supplement improved marathon finishing times.

passages.title: Supplement trial
passages.text: Marathon finishing times did not improve with supplementation; the supplement group was on average 40 seconds slower than placebo, a non-significant difference in the opposite direction.

passages.title: Adherence note
passages.text: Adherence to the supplementation protocol exceeded 90% in both groups.

cases.label_basis: Passage 1 states the opposite of the claim: no improvement, direction reversed.

cases.claim: Daily meditation lowers systolic blood pressure by at least 8 mmHg in hypertensive adults.

passages.title: Meditation overview
passages.text: Meditation practices have grown in popularity and are studied for a range of stress-related outcomes. Programs vary widely in duration and technique.

passages.title: Hypertension background
passages.text: Hypertension affects roughly one in three adults and is a major risk factor for cardiovascular disease.

cases.label_basis: Both passages are topical but neither states anything about meditation's effect size on blood pressure.

cases.claim: Water boils at approximately 100 degrees Celsius at sea-level atmospheric pressure.

passages.title: Espresso extraction
passages.text: Espresso machines extract coffee at around nine bars of pressure, with brew temperatures typically between 90 and 96 degrees Celsius.

passages.title: Kettle market report
passages.text: Electric kettle sales grew steadily, with consumers favouring models with temperature presets.

cases.label_basis: The claim is true in the world, but no passage in the pool states it. Absence from the pool must yield not_enough_evidence, never contradicted - this case exists to pin that rule.

cases.claim: The vaccine was 95% effective against symptomatic infection in the trial.

passages.title: Trial efficacy report
passages.text: Vaccine efficacy against symptomatic infection was 66% in the primary analysis, with confidence intervals from 57% to 74%.

passages.title: Safety summary
passages.text: No serious safety concerns were identified during the follow-up period.

cases.label_basis: The passage states a materially different efficacy figure (66% vs the claimed 95%) for the same outcome in the same trial framing.

cases.claim: The cohort study followed participants for a median of eight years and recorded dietary intake annually.

passages.title: Cohort methods
passages.text: Participants were followed for a median of eight years. Dietary intake was recorded with a validated food-frequency questionnaire administered annually.

passages.title: Cohort funding note
passages.text: The study was funded by a national research council grant.

cases.label_basis: Both halves of the claim (follow-up duration and annual dietary recording) are stated verbatim in the methods passage.

cases.claim: The medication lowered LDL cholesterol by 30% and eliminated cardiovascular risk.

passages.title: Lipid trial outcomes
passages.text: The medication lowered LDL cholesterol by 30% versus baseline. Cardiovascular events were reduced but not eliminated; residual risk remained substantial in all treatment groups.

cases.label_basis: The 30% LDL reduction is stated exactly; the elimination of cardiovascular risk is explicitly negated ('reduced but not eliminated').

cases.claim: Screen time among teenagers declined steadily between 2015 and 2020.

passages.title: Adolescent media survey
passages.text: Average daily screen time among teenagers rose each year from 2015 to 2020, with the largest single-year increase recorded in 2020.

passages.title: Survey methodology
passages.text: The survey sampled approximately 3,000 adolescents annually using a consistent instrument.

cases.label_basis: The passage states the opposite direction over the same period: rose each year rather than declined steadily.

cases.claim: The retraining programme doubled the employment rate of participants within one year.

passages.title: Programme description
passages.text: The retraining programme offers six-month courses in software testing and logistics, with roughly 400 participants enrolled each cohort.

passages.title: Labour market overview
passages.text: Regional unemployment fell modestly during the study period amid broad economic recovery.

cases.label_basis: Passages describe the programme and the labour market but state no employment outcome for participants; the modest regional decline neither supports nor contradicts a doubling claim.

cases.claim: The human heart has four chambers.

passages.title: Exercise physiology note
passages.text: Regular aerobic exercise improves stroke volume and resting heart rate over time.

passages.title: Hospital staffing report
passages.text: Cardiology departments reported increased outpatient volumes last year.

cases.label_basis: A textbook-true anatomical fact that no passage in the pool states. Absence from the pool must yield not_enough_evidence, never contradicted - second anchor for the absence-is-not-falsity rule.
